title: Jobdeck access-token claims
description: Claims carried in access tokens issued by Jobdeck Auth. Signature, issuer, audience, and time validation are performed by the JWT verifier, not by JSON Schema validation.

iss.description: Issuer identifier for Jobdeck Auth. JWT consumers must validate it.

aud.description: Intended recipients. It is always represented as a JSON array, including for one audience. JWT consumers must require their own audience.

exp.description: Expiry NumericDate: seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. JWT consumers must reject expired tokens.

actor_type.description: Kind of authenticated actor: USER is a human account; SERVICE is a machine or service account.
